description: DST-aware previous-value and thirty-minute initial-balance opening-type router with separate five-minute trigger

cost_assumptions.rationale: Every fill costs 6 bp. Bar-only market entry reserves one tick for synthetic executable-side crossing and one tick from OneTickSlippageFillModel. Stop execution reserves shifted prior-hour ten-second true-range Q99. Official funding, mark price and native liquidation remain enabled.
cost_assumptions.actual_funding_settlement: checksum-verified Binance Vision monthly fundingRate archives with native mark-price settlement
cost_assumptions.stop_market_slippage_reserve: shifted Q99 of completed ten-second true range over the preceding sixty minutes, minimum one tick

scenario_contract.market_mechanism: Major activity windows in a continuous market behave as recurring opening auctions. Previous UTC-day value locates accepted inventory; the complete session initial balance reveals whether outside value was accepted, tested and accepted, or rejected. A separate post-IB displacement starts the tradeable leg.

sessions.LONDON: 08:00 Europe/London converted to UTC for each local date
sessions.NEW_YORK: 09:30 America/New_York converted to UTC for each local date

scenario_contract.previous_value: Exactly 288 contiguous completed five-minute bars from the prior UTC day; volume-weighted typical-price VWAP plus/minus one weighted sigma.
scenario_contract.initial_balance: Exactly six contiguous completed five-minute bars at the actual session open.

state_router.OPEN_DRIVE: Session opens outside previous value and the entire completed IB remains beyond that value edge.
state_router.OPEN_TEST_DRIVE: Session opens outside previous value, tests it during the IB, but completed IB close and IB VWAP remain outside.
state_router.OPEN_REJECTION_REVERSE: Session opens outside previous value but completed IB close and IB VWAP return inside the rejected edge.
state_router.UNRESOLVED: Session opens inside value or completed IB location and value disagree; no trade.

scenario_contract.trigger: A separate completed M5 displacement. Initiative states require a close beyond the IB edge; responsive rejection requires a close through IB midpoint toward previous value.
scenario_contract.entry: First contiguous completed ten-second execution observation after the M5 trigger. Ten-second data does not choose context, state, direction, stop or target.
scenario_contract.initiative_stop: Beyond the more adverse of the accepted IB edge and trigger-bar opposite extreme, plus 0.05 trigger ATR and at least 0.10 ATR from entry.
scenario_contract.initiative_target: Exactly one completed IB width beyond the accepted edge, frozen before trigger.
scenario_contract.responsive_stop: Beyond the rejected IB extreme plus 0.05 trigger ATR and at least 0.10 ATR from entry.
scenario_contract.responsive_target: The opposite edge of the completed previous-day value range, frozen before the session.
scenario_contract.one_attempt: At most one routed trade per session; unresolved, invalidated, consumed or uneconomic states are not retried.
scenario_contract.development_data: Prior candidate weeks are not used. Three new weeks were selected before running this candidate using seed 4082026 and exclusion of previously used weeks plus/minus twenty-one days.
